flashlight.notes: First-person torch, 0.24 m, built pointing at Blender -Y as the brief asks, so in three.js the beam leaves along +Z: turn it half a turn about Y to aim it down the camera. Origin is the middle of the grip. Lens and bulb are lamp_glow. Not a placed prop, so mount is "held".

battery.notes: Pickup: a 6 V lantern battery, 0.14 m tall. Yellow label on all four sides.

time_clock.notes: Watchman's punch clock. Origin at the centre of the back. The lever (child `lever`) is hinged on the right side and turns about X; pull it down to punch. The round lamp at lower right is status_glow.

generator.notes: Hand-crank generator on a skid, 1.4 x 0.8 footprint. The crank wheel (child `crank`) is on the front, axle along the depth axis (three.js Z), and overhangs the skid by about 0.2 m toward the player.

charger_dock.notes: Charging rack for three torches. Origin at the centre of the back. The dome on the transformer box is status_glow.

door_panel.notes: Door control box. Origin at the centre of the back. Child `button` is the mushroom head: push it along three.js -Z (into the box) by up to 0.012 m. The lamp above it is status_glow.

booth_door.notes: Shutter slab that fills a 2.6 x 3.0 doorway. Origin at the bottom centre; slide it up by 3 m to open. The outside (clawed) face is three.js +Z.

vent_cover.notes: Louvred grate over a vent mouth. Origin at the centre of the back. The dark sheet behind the slats stands in for the duct; one slat is missing and one is bent.

fuse_box.notes: Fuse box with its door hanging open. Origin at the centre of the back of the 0.5 x 0.7 box; the open door swings out to the left and reaches about 0.6 m in front of the wall, so leave that space clear.

desk.notes: Security desk, 2.4 x 0.9, top at 0.75 m. The guard sits on the three.js +Z side (drawers and kneehole face that way). Clutter is modelled on the front 0.4 m of the top and both ends; the rear middle 1.8 x 0.5 is left clear for monitor_bank.

office_chair.notes: Swivel chair. Seat at 0.48 m, faces three.js +Z, turned a few degrees as if someone just left.

monitor_bank.notes: Three CRT monitors on a rack, made to sit on the desk top (origin at the centre of its footprint). Screens are screen_glow and carry a dead-channel picture as base colour and emissive map; from the viewer's left to right they map to atlas pictures screen_0, screen_1, screen_2.

wall_map.notes: Framed pin board. Origin at the centre of the back. Child `map_face` is a flat 1.64 x 0.76 plane (material `map`, UVs 0..1, U to the viewer's right, V up) for the live floor plan. The strip below it holds a title plate, a calendar and a note.

locker.notes: Two-door steel locker, 0.9 x 0.5 x 1.9. Doors face three.js +Z. The left door stands a few degrees open on a dark interior.

coat_rack.notes: Coat stand with a guard jacket and a cap. The jacket hangs on the right-hand hook, so it reads like a figure standing in the corner.

ceiling_light.notes: Twin-tube fluorescent batten, 1.2 m, hangs below the origin (centre of its top). Both tubes are lamp_glow.

hanging_bulb.notes: Bare bulb on a 0.8 m flex. Origin at the top of the cord; the bulb (lamp_glow) is centred about 0.91 m below it. The game may swing the whole prop about its origin.

exit_sign.notes: Emergency exit box. Origin at the centre of the back. The lettered face is exit_glow, with the picture as both base colour and emissive map.

pipe_run.notes: Three pipes on two trapeze hangers, a 2 m module running along three.js Z; modules butt end to end. Origin at the centre of the top (the ceiling). About 0.6 wide and 0.5 deep including the valve wheel that hangs below.

duct_run.notes: Sheet-metal duct, a 2 m module running along three.js Z; modules butt end to end (the ends are dark, as if open). Origin at the centre of the top; the duct hangs 0.08 m below it on straps. A grille faces down near one end.

wall_fan.notes: Extractor fan in a 1.2 m square frame, 0.3 deep. Origin at the centre of the back. Child `blades` spins about the depth axis (three.js Z) at the hub. A wire guard covers the front.

crate.notes: Wooden shipping crate, 1 m cube, lid slightly lifted. Stencils and a shipping label on the three.js +Z face.

cardboard_box.notes: Cardboard box, 0.5 m, sagging and taped, damp at the bottom. Printing on the three.js +Z face.

barrel.notes: Oil drum, 0.58 across, 0.88 tall, dented. Label and stencil face three.js +Z.

pallet.notes: Timber pallet, 1.2 x 1.0 x 0.15, one deck board broken.

wet_floor_sign.notes: Folding wet-floor sign, 0.62 tall; the two printed faces look along three.js +Z and -Z.

mop_bucket.notes: Mop bucket on castors with a wringer and a mop standing in it; the mop handle leans to 1.35 m.

trash_bag.notes: A full bin bag slumped on the floor with a smaller one against it; a party hat has poked through the small one.

fire_extinguisher.notes: Dry-powder extinguisher on a wall bracket. Origin at the centre of the back of the bracket; the cylinder hangs 0.09 m in front of the wall.
